cases.mechanism_detail: The 2672-bp retrotransposon in TAF1 intron 32 is associated with reduced TAF1 expression in patient iPSCs and spiny projection neurons; CRISPR excision of the insertion increased TAF1 expression. Element class not named in the abstract.
cases.quote: TAF1 reduction in X-linked dystonia-parkinsonism is likely due to the retrotransposon insertion and is recapitulated in induced pluripotent stem cells and differentiated spiny projection neurons.
